newsitem.title: USA: KANSAS FED CATTLE SELL UP $1 AT $65, BRISK - USDA.
newsitem.headline: KANSAS FED CATTLE SELL UP $1 AT $65, BRISK - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher, USDA said. Inquiry was good and demand fairly good.
Wk to date - 104,200 last week- 58,600 last year- 24,300

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1320 lbs 65.00, pen 1375 lbs 64.00, pen 1400 lbs 62.00; few Select with end Choice 1175-1200 lbs 64.00-65.00; few Select and Choice 1350 lb Holsteins 59.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1125 lbs 65.00; few Select with end Choice 64.50; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1075-1200 lb heifers and heiferettes 62.50-63.00.

Sales confirmed on 34,600 slaughter steers and 33,600 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 104,200 head confirmed including 32,100 head or about 31 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
